### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what the feature should accomplish.

### Problem / Motivation
What administrative or student bottleneck does this address?

### Proposed Solution
Explain your proposed technical or workflow design.

### Human-in-the-Loop & Privacy Impact
- Does this introduce any automated irreversible actions? (Yes/No)
- Does this involve new student data fields requiring PII masking? (Yes/No)
